blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: You'll get over this.
exercises.why: **оправиться → оправитесь** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: I will introduce her to you.
exercises.why: **познакомить → познакомлю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: He is going to destroy the economy.
exercises.why: **развалить → развалит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Ты ___ (упасти) своего отца от переживаний, попросту написав письмо.
exercises.prompt: You will save your father a lot of worry if you simply write him a letter.
exercises.why: **упасти → упасешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: How many teams will be relegated to the lower league?
exercises.why: **перейти → перейдут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Ask and you shall receive.
exercises.why: **даться → дастся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Может статься, что люди ___ (израсходовать) всю нефть на Земле.
exercises.prompt: The time may come when people will have used up all the oil.
exercises.why: **израсходовать → израсходуют** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Let's go out on the balcony.
exercises.why: **выйти → выйдем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: One day, the truth will be revealed.
exercises.why: **всплыть → всплывёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: It cannot be helped.
exercises.why: **поделать → поделаешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: This oil well is going to make me rich.
exercises.why: **обогатить → обогатит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Can I have a little sip?
exercises.why: **отпить → отопью** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: If I'm late, I'll be scolded.
exercises.why: **успеть → успею** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: They will release the hostages.
exercises.why: **отпустить → отпустят** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Вот моя рука. Вместе мы ___ (создать) утопию, ты и я.
exercises.prompt: Take my hand. We'll build a utopia, you and me.
exercises.why: **создать → создадим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: He's going to join our club.
exercises.why: **вступить → вступит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Ждать, что Том ___ (признать) свою неправоту, можно хоть до морковкиного заговенья.
exercises.prompt: You'll be waiting till hell freezes over before Tom will admit that he's wrong.
exercises.why: **признать → признает** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Капиталисты ___ (продать) нам верёвку, на которой мы их повесим.
exercises.prompt: The Capitalists will sell us the rope with which we will hang them.
exercises.why: **продать → продадут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Эти проклятые комары из нас всю кровь ___ (высосать).
exercises.prompt: These sodding mosquitoes will suck all our blood out of us.
exercises.why: **высосать → высосут** — perfective verb, 3rd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Wait until the page loads.
exercises.why: **загрузиться → загрузится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
